question: Can the same small plastic circuit retain nonlinear triangle binding and ordinary independent-object memory by practising both during development?
paired_training: Start from exactly the same twelve uniform-query graphs as the existing 64k triangle trajectory. Original six and independently initialized six keep their respective original training streams. The existing fixed zero-sum triangle is the hard-only arm. Add an easy-only arm (three orthogonal cues) and an interleaved arm (within each four updates, two exact zero-sum triangles, one orthogonal triple and one unstructured triple of independent directions, in randomized order). All arms receive every one of eight private label maps per geometry, three actual supports, a single actual paid final choice, the same training clocks, motor/edit draws, optimizer, and total updates. No extra parameter, readout or explicit target label.
primary: At the same total budget compare the hard, interleaved and orthogonal graduates on strict retention of both hard maps over exact held-out triangles and on all-three and all-five actual ordinary independent-object answers. A second comparison matches the number of exact hard updates in mixed-64k and hard-32k. Report tradeoffs separately; do not select an arm by hindsight or combine tasks into one score.
transfer: Also measure ordinary A and most-recent at higher load, first actions for new objects under a new related rule, and native serial context-plus-mark choices, with no further optimization of the evaluated graph. The three-item generalization uses independent scent directions and all eight value assignments; it need not be linear or conflict-free.
deadline: Fixed 64k endpoints if complete before the overnight cutoff. Report the predetermined 32k endpoint and explicitly mark later censored work if hardware performance is insufficient.
